name: Compliant Naira
who_can_redeem: Verified KYC-compliant users may burn cNGN for an equivalent amount of Nigerian Naira under WrappedCBDC Terms.
redemption_region_notes: WrappedCBDC services are subject to account verification and applicable regulatory/service restrictions.
redemption_notes: Minting accepts Naira deposits only; redemption burns cNGN and returns equivalent Naira to the user's designated account, subject to applicable network and processing fees.
summary: Nigerian-naira stablecoin issued by WrappedCBDC Limited, backed 1:1 by Naira-denominated reserves and available across multiple blockchain networks.
notes: Current issuer materials report active circulation and reserve coverage. Proposed record ID is namespaced to avoid conflating this WrappedCBDC asset with the separate Celo/Mento cNGN symbol lineage.
